name: Heathfield Square, Knutsford
notes: Doubt: the council's 'Conservation Area Maps' list and its count of 76 do not include this area, but the council publishes its appraisal (Macclesfield Borough Council, September 2007) among the conservation area appraisals, and the Cheshire HER layer published by the council holds it as 'Active', assigned 2006-10-23 (reference DesigUID DCH14476). The name follows the council's appraisal list ('Heathfield Square Knutsford'). The name warning against PDP 44012922 'Knutsford' is a partial match only: the HER polygon (2.2 ha) touches the Town Centre (Knutsford) polygon but does not overlap it.
